metadata.name: TCS iON Frontend Clone - Exam Mode UI

core_requirements.requirement: 60-MINUTE TIMER (Server-Enforced) - Display: MM:SS format (59:45, counting down every 1 second) - Client polls server every 5 seconds: GET /api/exams/{exam_id}/time-remaining - Server returns: {seconds_remaining, time_expired: boolean} - Submit validation backend: if (now - started_at) > 3600: reject with 403 - Color: Green normal → Yellow <15min → Red <5min - Why server-enforced: Prevents user browser manipulation (cheating prevention)

QUESTION PALETTE (50-Cell Grid) - Layout: 7 columns × 8 rows (fits in right panel) - Scrollable: shows all 50 Qs, scroll if needed - Status indicators: * ■ (filled green): Answered * □ (empty white): Unanswered * ★ (orange star): Marked for Review * Current Q: Blue border + light blue background - Click any cell: Jump to that question (strategic navigation) - User can see progress at a glance (exam strategy tool)

SEQUENTIAL NAVIGATION (Realistic Exam) - Previous button: only goes to Q-1 (disabled on Q1) - Next button: only goes to Q+1 (disabled on Q50) - Cannot skip ahead (forces realistic exam pacing) - Palette click allowed (strategic navigation, not cheating) - Keyboard: Arrow keys work, Ctrl+N/P for navigation

ANSWER PERSISTENCE (Unbreakable) - Auto-save to localStorage every 2 seconds (even if user doesn't change) - Sync to server every 30 seconds: POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/save-answers - On page reload: recover from localStorage (resume mid-exam) - If localStorage cleared: recover from server backup - User never loses an answer mid-exam

NEGATIVE MARKING DISPLAY (+4 / -1 / 0) - Every question shows: "Correct: +4 | Wrong: -1 | Blank: 0" - Backend calculates: score = sum of (4 for correct, -1 for wrong, 0 for blank) - Max score: 200 (all 50 correct) - Min score: -50 (all wrong, unlikely) - Typical range: 60-160 - User knows stakes of every question

SUBMIT BUTTON BEHAVIOR - Disabled before time < 5 minutes - Enabled at 5:00 remaining (T-300 seconds) - Tooltip: "Submit enabled with < 5 minutes remaining" - Click Submit → send answers to backend, backend validates time - Auto-submit: On time = 0 or user submits - No more answering after submit

RESULTS PAGE (Immediate Feedback) - Score display: "156/200 (78%)" - Topic breakdown: accuracy % per topic (18 topics) - Weak areas detected: topics with accuracy <60% flagged CRITICAL - Next action recommended: "DRILL on TAS (critical)" - "View Detailed Breakdown" option for question-by-question review

project.state_machine:
IDLE ↓ user clicks "Attempt Mock" LOADING (fetching 50 questions) ↓ questions loaded (GET /api/exams/start) ACTIVE (user answering, timer running) ↓ time < 300 seconds LAST_5_MINUTES (submit button enabled, red timer) ↓ time < 60 seconds LAST_1_MINUTE (pulse animation, auto-submit warning) ↓ time = 0 OR user clicks Submit SUBMITTING (POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/submit) ↓ score calculated RESULTS (display score, breakdown, weak areas) ↓ user clicks "Back to Dashboard" or "New Mock" IDLE (ready for next exam)
TRANSITIONS ON: - TIME_UPDATE (every 5 sec from server) - USER_ANSWER (radio button click) - MARK_REVIEW (checkbox toggle) - NAVIGATE_Q (button click or palette cell) - SUBMIT_CLICKED (submit button) - AUTO_SUBMIT (time expired)

timer_implementation.server_side_validation:
Backend endpoint: POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/submit
1. Load exam_sessions: {started_at, time_limit_seconds} 2. elapsed = now - started_at 3. IF elapsed > time_limit_seconds: return 403 with message "Exam time expired" 4. ELSE: accept submission, calculate score, return 200
This prevents user from bypassing client timer via direct API call.

persistence_strategy.recovery_on_reload:
When user reloads page mid-exam:
1. Check localStorage for 'exam_'+exam_id 2. IF found: - Parse saved state - Get time-remaining from server - IF time_reached: restore UI at last Q - Hydrate context from localStorage - Show "Exam resumed. 45:30 remaining." 3. IF not found OR exam expired: - Show "Exam already completed. View results."
User never loses progress.

project.keyboard_shortcuts:
Ctrl+N / Cmd+N: Next question (Q+1) Ctrl+P / Cmd+P: Previous question (Q-1) Ctrl+R / Cmd+R: Toggle "Mark for Review" Ctrl+S / Cmd+S: Submit (only if time < 5 min, else beep)
Arrow Right: Next question Arrow Left: Previous question Tab: Navigate between option radio buttons Enter/Space: Select focused option Number 1-4: Quick select option A/B/C/D (1=A, 2=B, etc.)
Power users: Full exam via keyboard, mouse optional.

error_scenarios.network_loss: - Toast: "Connection lost. Answers saved locally." - Timer: continues polling (retry every 5 sec) - User: can keep answering (localStorage backup) - Reconnect: batch POST saved answers, sync to server, resume - Alert if disconnected >2 min: "Submit answers locally?"
error_scenarios.time_expired: - Auto-submit: POST answers with current state - Backend: enforces time check (accepts if within window) - Show: "Time expired. Exam submitted." - Results: displayed immediately
error_scenarios.question_load_timeout: - If Gemini takes >10 sec to generate 50 Qs: * Show spinner: "Generating your personalized exam..." * If >30 sec: error "Unable to load exam. Return to Dashboard."
error_scenarios.submit_api_failure: - If POST submit times out (>10 sec): * Show: "Submission failed. Retrying..." * Retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff * If all fail: "Keep answers local OR exit?" (localStorage backup available)
error_scenarios.browser_sleep: - Laptop sleeps mid-exam - On tab resume: sync timer immediately - If time expired while asleep: auto-submit current answers - Else: resume exam normally

testing.unit_tests: Core logic tests (Jest): - timer countdown (5 tests): state transitions, color changes - answer persistence (8 tests): localStorage save/load, sync - question navigation (7 tests): prev/next, palette click, bounds - palette UI (6 tests): answered/unanswered/marked indicators - mark for review (4 tests): toggle, persistence, display - submit validation (5 tests): button enabled state, API call - error scenarios (8 tests): network loss, timeout, recovery - keyboard shortcuts (3 tests): Ctrl+N, Ctrl+P, Ctrl+S - accessibility (4 tests): ARIA labels, focus management, contrast
testing.integration_tests: Multi-component workflows (Jest + React Testing Library): - full exam attempt: start → q1-q50 → submit → results - exam resumption: close browser → reopen → resume from q21 - network recovery: lose connection → restore → sync answers - timer enforcement: server rejects submit if time exceeded - scoring: 40 correct + 10 wrong = 156/200 (verified) - weak areas: accuracy <60% on TAS → detected as CRITICAL - navigation: palette click + buttons + keyboard - localStorage backup: clear cache → recover from server
testing.e2e_tests: End-to-end in real browser (Selenium): - full exam in Chrome: start → 30 Qs answered → submit → results (5 min) - keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+N, Ctrl+P, Ctrl+S all work - mobile responsiveness: exam on iPhone (portrait/landscape) - timer accuracy: compare client + server time (no drift >5s) - cross-browser: Chrome + Firefox + Safari
testing.coverage_target: - Statements: >85% - Branches: >80% - Functions: >90% - Lines: >85% (exam-mode.tsx is critical, test thoroughly)

accessibility.screen_reader:
ARIA labels on every interactive element: - Timer: aria-live="polite" aria-label="Time remaining: 59 minutes 45 seconds" - Palette cells: aria-label="Question 15, current, unanswered" - Options: aria-label="Option B, Consectetur adipiscing elit" - Buttons: aria-label="Next question, navigates to question 16"
Screen reader announces: - Current question number + status - Timer updates (announced every 10 sec, or at 5/1 min) - Option selected - Palette cell focused
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard support: - Tab: navigate between options (4 radio buttons) - Arrow: navigate questions - Enter/Space: select option - Ctrl+shortcuts: quick actions - Focus visible: blue outline (4px, high contrast) - NO keyboard trap: can reach all UI via Tab
accessibility.color_contrast: - Timer text: 7:1 ratio (white on #003A70 dark blue) - Selected option: 5:1 ratio (white on #0066CC blue) - Option text: 7:1 ratio (black on white) - Palette cells: 4.5:1 minimum (green text on white) - Alert colors: not rely on color alone (also icons: 🔴, ⚠️)
accessibility.text_sizing: - Question text: 16px minimum - Options: 14px minimum - Timer: 24px (prominent) - Palette cells: 12px (small but readable) - Zooms correctly up to 200%

project.performance: - 50 questions load: <500ms (parallel Gemini generation on backend) - Timer display update: 60fps smooth (requestAnimationFrame) - Palette cell click: <100ms (instant navigation) - Answer save to localStorage: <10ms (never blocking) - Submit endpoint: <2s (score calculation) - Results page render: <1s (breakdown displayed) - Page reload recovery: <2s (hydrate context + fetch time) - Mobile responsiveness: <3 sec on 4G

deployment.staging: - Deploy to staging environment - Run all 70 tests (pass 100%) - Load test: 100 concurrent exam attempts - Verify: timer accuracy, submit success, results correctness - Performance baseline: all targets met
deployment.production_rollout:
Phase 1 (Day 1): Deploy with feature flag OFF - Code in production, route disabled - Status: "Exam mode coming soon"
Phase 2 (Day 2): Enable for 10% of traffic - Monitor: error_rate, timer_accuracy, submit_success - Alert thresholds: error >2%, timer_drift >10s, submit_fail >5%
Phase 3 (Day 3): Ramp to 50% if stable - Continue monitoring (24h observation) - Dashboard: real-time metrics visible
Phase 4 (Day 4): Ramp to 100% if no issues - Full availability - Ongoing monitoring
ROLLBACK: Single-line config change (feature flag = false)
deployment.monitoring_metrics: - Exam start count: exams/minute - Submit success rate: % (target >99%) - Error rate: % of exams with errors - Timer accuracy: deviation from server (seconds, target ±5s) - Submit latency: p50, p95, p99 (target p99 <5s) - localStorage failures: % (target <0.1%) - Connection loss recovery: % success (target >98%) - Results correctness: % (verify spot samples)

project.timeline:
WEEK 3 (Backend parallel): - Days 1-2: Component design + React Context types + CSS Grid (150 LOC) - Days 3-4: Exam UI build + timer widget + palette grid (800 LOC) - Day 5: Backend API integration (mock endpoints) + unit tests (25 tests)
WEEK 6 (Integration + Polish): - Days 1-2: E2E testing (Selenium) + debugging - Days 3-4: Performance tuning (60fps, <500ms load) - Day 5: Accessibility audit + screen reader testing - Days 6-7: Error handling+ edge cases + production polish
TOTAL: 12 days (1.7 weeks) PARALLEL with backend: No sequential bottleneck CRITICAL PATH: Aligned with Week 3-6 backend execution
